title: "Restoration Features Crosswalk to Environmental Design Handbook Chapters"
format: html

Environmental Design Handbook, 2012 documents the array of restoration tools and lessons learned to aid in the design of future Habitat Rehabilitation and Enhancement Projects (HREP). These restoration tools include shoreline protection, island creation, water level management, backwater dredging, secondary channel modifications and river training structures, aeration, and floodplain and tributary restoration. These tools are captured to a GIS database as Restoration Features for mapping, analysis for feature impact, and future planning.

The following provides restoration features alignment to the chapters of the design handbook.

## Chapter 4
### Shoreline and Riverbank Protection
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Revetments
Riverine Flow Structures (line and polygon)
Embankments (line and polygon)

## Chapter 5
### Water Level Management
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Dredging
Fish Structures
Embankments (line and polygon)
Moist Soil Management Units
Pump Stations
Wells

## Chapter 6
### Dredging
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Dredging
Embankments (line and polygon)
Water Control Structures

## Chapter 7
### River Training Structures and Secondary Channel Modification
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Riverine Flow Structures (line and polygon)
Fishing Structures
Notches
Revetments

## Chapter 8
### Floodplain Restoration
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Wetlands
Flora Planting and Seeding
Dredging

## Chapter 9
### Island Design
Includes the following Restoration Features:

Island (line and polygon)
Dredging
Notches
Riverine Flow Structures (line and polygon)
Wetlands
